label: Search our tenant, read-only
authored_by: the site, as a starting point — not measured, not surveyed; the first thing to argue with
description: We connected Claude to Microsoft 365 so people could search their mail, their chats and SharePoint. Reading is what we wanted. Nobody asked for it to send mail or post in Teams as them, and the administrator who consented read the page when it said read-only.

notes.send.message.world: refused; bounded by Mail.Send, which only the administrator can revoke
notes.read.file.host: wanted — and tenant-wide, which is more than anybody pictured

provenance.note: Written on this site as the starting mandate for a connector shape the model site has not published. A mandate is elicited, not measured: this is a first draft written to be argued with. `unstated` is the primitives the mandate names neither way.
